articles.title: Volunteers Turn Out for the Fall Cleanup Across Marsh Landing

articles.title: Letters: Orion Avenue Parking Is Out of Control
body: To the editor: I have lived on Orion Avenue for 23 years, and I want to say what a difference the Upper Commons Historical Society has made.
Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed. Please keep the after-school reading program in the budget. Many of us on Orion Avenue use it every week.
Sergio Renner, Marsh Landing

articles.title: Zoning Board Hears Plan for Tool Library Near Foundry Row
articles.deck: Supporters and opponents on Calder Avenue disagreed about cost and timing.
body: The ordinance will return to the agenda at the next regular session, unless the chair calls a special meeting first. Councilmember Brian McIver asked for more time to review the proposal, which would cost about $25,000.

Staff recommended approval with two conditions: a traffic study and a public notice period of 30 days. Residents of Foundry Row said they had been asking for action for years, and several brought photographs of the street.
